comment: ADR-005 D3 — the migration-ownership map both engines read. Two systems never own the same table. owner=python-ts-transition marks shared tables the engine touches during the strangler window (documented dual-write seams); owner=engine-ts tables are created and owned by this engine's drizzle migrations.

billing.spend_events.note: the engine metering plane's OWN table (schema billing) — distinct from the Python-owned public.spend_events until handover A-3; satellites ingest here idempotently by (source, event_id).

studio_project_keys.note: key rows stay Python-owned (api_keys); the project BINDING is engine-owned — one authority per fact; key-row write authority transfers at handover A-1.

satellites.note: the satellite registry: agent-runtime live; inference PRE-REGISTERED as a placeholder (trigger-gated, ADR-006 D4).

published_configs.note: engine-published policy/guardrail/quota/model-catalog documents per (org x scope x product) — handover A-4's store; RLS org-scoped; append-only versions (notes + rollback lineage since eng-0016; retention-pruned to the newest CONFIG_VERSION_RETENTION per key).

config_drafts.note: the mutable draft layer over published_configs (one per org x scope x product) — validates on save, stores its verdict, publishes snapshot into an immutable version; RLS org-scoped.

config_notifications.note: durable push-notification ledger for satellite config fanout; satellites ACK after applying; the satellites sweeper reads it for config_drift incidents (documented read-only seam); ACKed rows age out per CONFIG_NOTIFICATION_RETENTION_DAYS.

tenants.shared: engine INSERTs new orgs (personal-org autocreation); UPDATEs features jsonb (staff flags, deletion markers — documented seam); Python remains the DDL authority. DDL transfer at agent-runtime handover A-1.

api_keys.shared: engine READS for L2 verification; the keys module WRITES issue/revoke rows and org deletion revokes org keys (dual-write seam, opened engine-side pre-A-1 per the EEP P5 note); additive columns project_id/owner_account_id/org_id land via Python Alembic 0017; full write authority transfers at handover A-1.

audit_events.shared: engine APPENDS identity/org events to the single hash-chained trail (doc-06 §10.7) using byte-identical chain semantics; never UPDATEs/DELETEs. DDL transfer with policy publishing (A-4).

spend_events.shared: engine-owned ingest lands in engine tables at billing B-1; this table stays runtime-owned until handover A-3.

end_users.shared: engine never touches until handover A-2 (account link alteration happens there).

operator_sessions.shared: read once by the I-1d data migration (TS script) into oauth_sessions, then obsolete at A-2.

account_action_tokens.note: single-use hashed tokens for emailed account actions (password reset, email verification).

revocation_events.note: the durable revocation log satellites poll (A-2 feed); append-only.

staff_impersonations.note: operational records of staff support sessions; tokens are OP-signed with imp/act claims.

billing.price_catalog.note: platform-authoritative pricing; ingest derives cost from it (BILLING_COST_VALIDATION).

org_deletions.note: staged deletion lifecycle: request → grace → purge; purge also marks the Python-owned tenants row deleted via its features jsonb (documented seam).

console_announcements.note: staff-managed platform announcements (status feed); operator-gated writes; visibility windowed.

billing.billing_credits.note: grants/trial/purchase balances applied at draft time, oldest-expiring-first; voids return credit.

billing.billing_credit_applications.note: per-invoice credit application records (children of credits + invoices, no org_id -> no RLS).

billing.billing_budgets.note: user-configured monthly budgets with threshold alerts (B-3); cycle-scoped notify state.

billing.billing_invoice_lines.note: invoice line-item breakdown (kind x model), generated at draft (B-5).

billing.billing_adjustments.note: signed credit/debit notes consumed by the next draft (B-7); single-consumption guard.

content_revisions.note: immutable post snapshots per save; restore writes a NEW revision.

newsletter_campaign_sends.note: per-recipient campaign records: dedupe + resume + suppression trail; carries the per-send unsubscribe token.

email_suppressions.note: hard bounces/complaints/unsubscribes — the email service refuses suppressed addresses.

assistants.note: stable assistant identity per org (one per name); active_version_id is atomic publish pointer; RLS org-scoped.

assistant_versions.note: immutable assistant versions (DRAFT->PUBLISHED) with model/context/tool/guardrail policies; RLS org-scoped; advisory-lock publish.

policy_snapshots.note: immutable policy snapshot 1:1 with published assistant_versions, materialized in the publish TX; runs pin policy_snapshot_id at acceptance (Phase 4.4); RLS org-scoped.

conversations.note: durable conversation boundary; assistant_id NOT NULL; optimistic version; RLS org-scoped.

conversation_participants.note: org/account/channel participants per conversation; RLS org-scoped.

messages.note: immutable messages; engine-allocated per-conversation sequence; RLS org-scoped.

runs.note: Engine run projection pinned to assistant_version + policy_snapshot; lease columns on row (pinned 2026-09-01); one active run per conversation (partial unique).

run_events.note: durable semantic events; producer event_id globally unique; authoritative engine_sequence per run; RLS org-scoped.

outbox_events.note: transactional outbox written in the same TX as the announced fact; pinned state machine PENDING->CLAIMED->PUBLISHED->RETRY_WAIT->DEAD_LETTER.

inbox_events.note: platform-plane consumer dedup ledger keyed (consumer_name,event_id); no tenant rows, no RLS by design.

idempotency_records.note: DB authority tier for idempotency (pulled forward from 6.7); Redis remains an ephemeral lease only.

run_idempotency.note: run-scoped RPC idempotency for MCP callers (org+caller_scope+key unique); RLS org-scoped.

approvals.note: human approval requests created via MCP CreateApprovalRequest; state PENDING->APPROVED/DENIED/EXPIRED; RLS org-scoped.

tool_effects.note: AuthorizeToolCall/RecordToolOutcome dedup ledger keyed (org,tool_call_id); digests stored as bytea; RLS org-scoped.

checkpoints.note: checkpoint claim-check pointers; bytes in object storage (Phase 7); unique (run,ref,version); RLS org-scoped.

memory_proposals.note: memory proposals are NOT durable truth until Engine policy decision (PENDING->APPROVED/REJECTED); RLS org-scoped.

artifacts.note: claim-check metadata; purpose allowlist; tenant-bound object_key org/{orgId}/{purpose}/{uuid}; RLS org-scoped.

upload_sessions.note: upload state machine CREATED->UPLOADING->UPLOADED->SCANNING->EXTRACTING->INDEXING->READY/QUARANTINED/FAILED; processing lease locked_at; RLS org-scoped.

documents.note: canonical knowledge documents derived from source artifacts; rebuildable; RLS org-scoped.

document_versions.note: versioned parsed representations (sha256+parser_version unique); RLS org-scoped.

chunks.note: derived chunks with source_range citations; rebuildable from artifact bytes; RLS org-scoped.

embeddings.note: pgvector(1536) embeddings keyed (chunk,model); derived; RLS org-scoped.

retrieval_acl.note: retrieval authorization applied BEFORE vector scoring (ledger 7.7); RLS org-scoped.

memory_items.note: durable memory; proposals become truth only on Engine approval (scope-typed, expiring, soft-deletable); RLS org-scoped.

usage_ledger_entries.note: append-only usage ledger; idempotent by (org,usage_event_id)+(org,idempotency_key); corrections via reversal_of compensating entries; never rewritten.

quota_reservations.note: RESERVED->COMMITTED/RELEASED quota state machine per org+dimension; expiry sweep reclaims; RLS org-scoped.

provider_reconciliation_runs.note: provider statements vs ledger vs entitlements comparison; discrepancies dead-lettered, never silently fixed; RLS org-scoped.

billing_webhook_inbox.note: inbound billing provider webhook state machine (received->signature_validated->deduplicated->processed/rejected/reconciliation_required); platform-plane, provider-keyed.

retention_policies.note: per-org resource/retention-class keep-until rules; RLS org-scoped.

legal_holds.note: active holds block purge for scope while unrelated retention work continues; RLS org-scoped.

export_requests.note: point-in-time authorized export manifest; one-time download token (hash-at-rest); expiry; RLS org-scoped.

purge_tasks.note: ordered deletion workflow (authorize->holds->unavailable->derived->objects->content->tombstone->done); resumable; RLS org-scoped.

tombstones.note: post-purge stale-ID rejection across MCP/console paths; platform-plane with evidence org.

data_access_records.note: sensitive-read stream (exports, support access, impersonation) separate from audit_events; append-only.

channel_accounts.note: channel plane: platform connections (messenger/whatsapp/telegram/web widget); envelope-sealed credentials; RLS org-scoped.

channel_identities.note: channel plane: platform user identity per account (psid/wa_id/chat_id/visitor); 24h messaging window state; RLS org-scoped.

channel_sessions.note: channel plane: website widget sessions; token stored as sha256 only; single conversation binding; RLS org-scoped.

channel_message_links.note: channel plane: inbound dedup + outbound delivery tracking per platform message id; RLS org-scoped.

channel_events.note: channel plane: durable webhook ingest inbox; unique (channel_account_id, external_event_id) dedup BEFORE side effects; RLS org-scoped.

tool_catalog.note: harness: org-scoped versioned tool definitions with JSON Schemas + effect/approval classes + MCP-aligned annotations; assistant versions pin by schema hash at publish; RLS org-scoped.

conversation_summaries.note: harness: immutable per-conversation compaction summaries (Studio-produced via MCP SaveConversationSummary); manifest serves newest covering the compiled window; RLS org-scoped.

message_feedback.note: harness: per-message user feedback (up/down + reason) feeding the eval pipeline via outbox; RLS org-scoped.

assistant_versions.budget_policy.note: harness FL-1.2: per-assistant RunBudgets authority (max_total_tokens, max_cost_micros, wall_clock_seconds, tool/model caps) pinned on the policy snapshot and served via the MCP ContextManifest; expand-only column.

escalations.note: harness FL-1.7: human handoff queue (WAITING→CLAIMED→RESOLVED) between the assistant and live agents; conversation status gains 'escalated' to pause the auto-responder; human replies flow through the ONE acceptMessage entry as 'service' participants; RLS org-scoped.

chunks.fts.note: FL-2.1: STORED tsvector generated column + GIN over chunk text — lexical leg of hybrid retrieval (FTS + pgvector in parallel, RRF fusion); derived/rebuildable.

documents.embedding_model.note: FL-2.2/2.3: embedding model the document's active vectors were computed with; drives the resumable re-embed worker and per-org model swaps.

memory_items.embedding.note: FL-2.4: approval-time embedding vector (HNSW cosine) enabling semantic memory search with ACL-before-scoring.

connector_accounts.note: FL-2.5: knowledge connector accounts (sitemap live; Drive/Notion/Confluence ports await per-tenant OAuth apps - documented seam). Sync flows through the existing upload-session pipeline; sealed credentials; RLS org-scoped.

eval_datasets.note: FL-2.21: org-scoped eval datasets (Engine system of record); Studio eval-worker executes. RLS org-scoped.

eval_cases.note: FL-2.21: bounded eval cases with tau2-style state assertions + LLM-judge rubrics. RLS org-scoped.

eval_runs.note: FL-2.21: eval run results (pass^k attempts, aggregate score) pinned to an assistant version. RLS org-scoped.

analytics_rollups.note: FL-2.22/2.23/2.24: daily CSAT/outcome/usage rollups computed by outbox consumers; unique per (org, kind, period, scope). RLS org-scoped.

tool_catalog.http_binding.note: FL-2.10: customer HTTP endpoint binding + enc:v1:-sealed per-tool credential + per-run rate limit; credential disclosure ONLY via the scoped GetToolCredential op.

conversation_shares.note: FL-3.4: public share links (sha256 token at rest, TTL/revocation). RLS org-scoped.

assistant_rollouts.note: FL-3.12: A/B canary traffic split beside the atomic publish pointer; sticky per-conversation assignment. RLS org-scoped.

run_judgments.note: FL-3.13: online LLM-as-judge verdicts on sampled runs; scores/verdicts only, transcript via claim-check. RLS org-scoped.

channel_message_templates.note: FL-3.18: provider-approved outbound templates per channel account. RLS org-scoped.

message_receipts.note: FL-3.19: inbound delivery/read receipts upserted from channel status events. RLS org-scoped.

messages.superseded_by.note: FL-3.3: set-once regeneration/edit branch pointer; messages stay immutable.

runs.regenerated_message_id.note: FL-3.3: the superseded assistant message a regeneration run replaces, committed atomically.

channel_accounts.platform.note: FL-3.17: platform vocabulary widened to instagram/x/email (additive CHECK widening).

platform_staff.note: AUTH-1.1: platform staff binding (super_admin/tenant_admin/operator/auditor) — the authority for the staff axis; platform-plane, no RLS (accounts posture); JWT claim is an optimization only.

org_memberships.uq_one_active_owner_per_.note: AUTH-1.5: partial unique index enforcing at most one active owner per org at the database; lower bound (>=1) stays application-level so the org purge can delete all memberships.

org_settings.kind.note: AUTH-2.1: personal | team workspace taxonomy; team workspaces are created via POST /console/org (AUTH-2.2). Python-owned tenants DDL untouched.

account_credentials.credential_id.note: AUTH-3.1: passkey credential id for WebAuthn rows (many per account); uniqueness reworked into partial unique indexes (one row per (account, kind) for non-WebAuthn kinds).

accounts.password_hash.note: AUTH-3.3 (eng-0047): column DROPPED — password material lives only in account_credentials kind='password' (single factor registry). Forward-fix only; no re-expansion.

rules: A table appears exactly once; its owner is the only system that may create/alter/drop it.
shared tables list the exact seam and the handover phase that transfers ownership.
Changing this file is a PR-reviewed act; the kernel startup self-check (K-5) verifies engine migrations only touch engine-ts-owned tables.
